name: PDF Editor Offline - Sign PDF
tagline: Edit, sign, merge, split & compress PDF 100% offline. No login, no upload.
description:
Offline PDF Editor & Sign is your all-in-one toolkit to process, edit, and manage PDF documents 100% offline, lightning-fast, and securely on your device without requiring an internet connection.

All document processing runs strictly inside your phone’s local memory (On-Device RAM Sandbox). Your private documents, business agreements, forms, and handwritten signatures are never uploaded to any cloud server.

Key Features of Offline PDF Editor & Sign:
🖋️ Digital Signature (E-Sign) Draw your signature or initials directly with your finger and place them onto any PDF page with precision scaling and positioning.

📝 PDF Editor & Annotation Add custom text notes, choose font families (Sans, Serif, Monospace), adjust font sizes and colors, and redact confidential sections.

📑 Merge & Split Documents Combine multiple PDF files into one neatly organized document, or extract and split specific page ranges in seconds.

🗜️ Compress PDF & Images Reduce the file size of PDF documents or photos while preserving optimal visual clarity for easy sharing via email or messaging apps.

🖼️ Convert PDF & Photos

Convert PDF pages into high-resolution images (exported as a ZIP archive).
Turn gallery photos and scans into a multi-page PDF document.
🔒 Protect & Lock PDF Encrypt your sensitive PDF files with password protection and strip unnecessary metadata.

💧 Watermark & Document Stamp Overlay copyright stamps, text watermarks, or confidentiality labels across all document pages.

📄 Resume Builder & LaTeX Equations Build ATS-friendly professional resumes ready for export, or render mathematical LaTeX formulas into crisp vector graphics.

Why Choose Offline PDF Editor & Sign?
✅ 100% Offline – Zero internet or mobile data required.
✅ Guaranteed Privacy – Zero telemetry and no data collection; your documents stay strictly on your device.
✅ Fast & Lightweight – No account registration, logins, or paid subscriptions needed.
✅ Dark Mode & Multi-Language – Native support for Dark Theme and bilingual interface (English & Indonesian).

name: Milo Cat: Space Platformer
tagline: Jump, dash & throw your boomerang! 2D space cat platformer, play offline.
description:

Step into the paws of Milo, a fearless and adorable orange tabby cat who has embarked on a daring mission across the galaxy! Immerse yourself in breathtaking 2D artwork! Explore a vibrant alien world filled with glowing flora, neon cities, and starry cosmic skies. Every jump, dash, and attack is accompanied by premium, high-quality sound effects and an epic soundtrack that will keep your heart racing!

• Fast-paced 2D platformer gameplay with intuitive mobile controls.

• Completely playable offline—no internet required!

The galaxy is calling, and only one cat can save it. Do you have what it takes to guide Milo to victory?

name: Fruit Match 3D: Triple Puzzle
tagline: Tap 3D fruit, match 3 and clear the crate before time runs out! Offline puzzle.
description:

Tap the fruit you want, send it to your tray and match 3 of a kind to make them pop. Be quick and chain matches for big combos. Be careful: when all 7 tray slots fill up, it's over!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap fruit in the crate to send it to the tray
• Match 3 of the same fruit to clear them
• Clear every fruit before the timer hits zero
• Chain quick matches for combo points and more stars

NEW CHALLENGES AS YOU GO
• Bombs: touch one and lose 10 seconds
• Frozen fruit: tap twice to break the ice
• Locked tray slots: less room to work with
• Rush mode: the clock is ticking faster
• Boss levels: everything at once, with a bigger reward

POWER-UPS WHEN YOU'RE STUCK
• Undo: put the last fruit back
• Shuffle: toss the pile to uncover hidden fruit
• Magic: automatically completes a set of three

COME BACK EVERY DAY
• Daily reward with a 7-day streak bonus
• Daily missions with coin rewards
• Lucky wheel with coins and power-ups
• Earn stars and coins on every level

MORE TO LOVE
• Smooth, colorful 3D graphics tuned for phones
• Sign in with Google Play for leaderboards and cloud save
• Plays offline (ads and online features need a connection)
• English and Bahasa Indonesia

Easy to pick up, hard to put down. Download Fruit Match 3D and see how far you can go!

name: Kucing Atur Duit: Catat Uang

description:

Fitur Utama

Keyboard Kalkulator

Masukkan nominal menggunakan keyboard kalkulator khusus. Kamu juga dapat langsung menghitung ekspresi seperti 50.000 + 20.000 × 2 sebelum menyimpan transaksi.

Tersedia nominal cepat seperti 10.000, 20.000, 50.000, dan 100.000 untuk mempercepat pencatatan.

Maskot Kucing Interaktif

Pilih kucing yang ingin menemani aktivitas keuanganmu. Tersedia beberapa karakter seperti Oren, Hitam, Putih, Abu-abu, dan Calico.

Maskot akan memberikan respons berdasarkan kondisi keuangan, misalnya ketika mendapatkan pemasukan, menghemat pengeluaran, mendekati batas anggaran, atau melewati anggaran yang sudah ditentukan.

Laporan Keuangan

Pantau kondisi keuangan melalui berbagai laporan yang mudah dibaca, termasuk:

• Komposisi pengeluaran berdasarkan kategori
• Perbandingan pemasukan dan pengeluaran
• Arus kas
• Perkembangan pengeluaran dari waktu ke waktu
• Ringkasan kondisi anggaran

Aplikasi juga dapat memberikan informasi sederhana mengenai perubahan pola pengeluaran.

Banyak Akun dan Buku

Kelola berbagai sumber keuangan dalam satu aplikasi, seperti:

• Tunai dan dompet
• Rekening bank
• E-wallet seperti GoPay, OVO, dan DANA
• Kartu kredit
• Utang dan piutang

Buat buku terpisah untuk kebutuhan pribadi, keluarga, usaha, atau perjalanan.

Anggaran Bulanan

Tentukan batas pengeluaran untuk setiap kategori dan pantau penggunaannya secara berkala.

Status anggaran dibagi menjadi:

• Aman: penggunaan di bawah 80%
• Waspada: penggunaan 80–99%
• Melebihi anggaran: penggunaan 100% atau lebih

Riwayat dan Kalender Transaksi

Lihat semua transaksi dalam bentuk daftar atau kalender. Gunakan filter berdasarkan kategori dan jenis transaksi, atau cari transaksi tertentu dengan mudah.

Tampilan kalender membantu melihat pola pengeluaran berdasarkan tanggal.

Privasi dan Keamanan

Kucing Atur Duit dirancang untuk menyimpan data keuangan langsung di perangkat.

• Data transaksi disimpan secara lokal
• Tidak membutuhkan koneksi internet untuk pencatatan
• Kunci aplikasi menggunakan PIN dan biometrik
• Backup dan restore lokal
• Opsi untuk menyembunyikan nominal transaksi
• Tanpa iklan banner yang mengganggu

Semua Fitur Gratis

Kucing Atur Duit dapat digunakan secara gratis tanpa fitur Premium atau langganan.

Seluruh fitur utama tersedia untuk digunakan, termasuk pencatatan transaksi, pengelolaan banyak akun dan buku, anggaran, laporan keuangan, kalender transaksi, pilihan maskot kucing, backup lokal, dan fitur privasi.

Aplikasi ini cocok untuk mencatat uang saku, kebutuhan sehari-hari, keuangan keluarga, maupun usaha kecil.

Mulai catat pemasukan dan pengeluaran dengan lebih teratur bersama Kucing Atur Duit.
